description: List capability tags in the mcp.film registry, ranked by number of matching servers (tag, page url, counts). Paged. Use get_film_capability for the server cluster behind one tag.

min_count.description: Only include capability tags with at least this many servers. Default 2 (tags with a published page).

offset.description: Start index for paging; use next_offset from the previous call.

name: list_film_capabilities
title: List capability tags
